# auth-zitadel-oauth2-proxy-integration

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> oauth2-proxy ↔ Zitadel Integration
>
> Provides the oauth2-values overlay that switches oauth2-proxy
> from Google to Zitadel as OIDC provider.
>
> The Traefik middleware chain remains UNCHANGED.
> Only the OIDC provider configuration changes.
>
> How to use in a tenant overlay:
>
> # kustomization.yaml
> resources:
> - ../../base
> - ../../components/apps/auth/zitadel               # Zitadel IdP
> - ../../components/apps/auth/zitadel/bootstrap      # IaC user setup
> - ../../components/apps/auth/zitadel/rbac           # K8s RBAC for bootstrap
>
> # Then in your oauth2-values.yaml, use the Zitadel OIDC values
> # (see oauth2-values-zitadel.yaml in this directory as template)
>
> What changes vs current Google setup:
> - provider: google → provider: oidc
> - Adds: oidc-issuer-url pointing to Zitadel
> - Adds: oidc-groups-claim for RBAC
> - Removes: Google-specific client-id
> - client-id/secret come from zitadel-oidc-credentials secret (auto-created by bootstrap)
